title: Require Domain Operation Source Topology
forbids: domain operation collections or operation roots outside the positive leaf contract, implementation, rules, and strategy spine
why: A module's ops directory contains semantic operation leaves only; the module contract and router already own declarative and executable aggregation. Complete input and output types remain contract-only, private implementation shapes stay with their sole owner, and shared semantic vocabulary moves to the nearest model atoms.
remediate: Place each operation under its owning domain module with contract.ts, index.ts, strategies, and optional rules. Compose leaf contracts directly in the module contract and leaf implementations directly in the module router; do not add collection-level registries or operation type bags.
message: Domain operations must match the positive operation blueprint spine.
